name: Kindred
title: The Eternal Hunters

Q.name: Dance of Arrows
Q.description: Kindred vaults, firing an arrow at up to 3 enemies, dealing 40/65/90/115/140 + 0.75×bonus AD physical damage and gaining 0.35 + ? Attack Speed for 4 seconds. While inside of Wolf's Frenzy, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to 4/3.5/3/2.5/2 seconds.
Q.summary: Kindred tumbles and shoots up to three arrows at nearby targets.

W.name: Wolf's Frenzy
W.description: Passive: Kindred gains stacks as they move and attack. At 100 stacks, Kindred's next Attack restores up to 47+ (by level) Health based on their missing Health. Active: Kindred claims a territory, ordering Wolf to bite at the last enemy Lamb Attacked. Wolf's bites deal 25/30/35/40/45 + 0.2×bonus AD + 0.2×AP plus 0.015 + ? current Health magic damage.
W.summary: Wolf enrages and attacks enemies around him. Lamb passively gains stacks by moving and attacking. When fully charged, Lamb's next attack restores health.

E.name: Mounting Dread
E.description: Kindred weakens an enemy, Slowing them by 30 + 0.05×AP% for 1.5 second. Kindred's third Attack against the target within 4 seconds of each other directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, dealing an additional (80/110/140/170/200 + 1×bonus AD) × (1 + (0.5×crit × (1×stat + -1))) plus (0.05 + ?) × (1 + (0.5×crit × (1×stat + -1))) missing Health physical damage.
E.summary: Lamb fires a carefully placed shot, slowing the target. If Lamb attacks the target two more times, her third attack instead directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, savaging them for massive damage.

R.name: Lamb's Respite
R.description: Kindred blesses the ground for 4 seconds, allowing no unit, ally, enemy, or neutral to die while inside. Upon reaching 10% Health, units can't be damaged or healed while still inside the zone. When the blessing ends, all units inside heal for 225/300/375 Health.
R.summary: Lamb grants all living things inside a zone a respite from death. Until the effect ends, nothing can die. At the end, units are healed.

Passive.name: Mark of the Kindred
Passive.description: Kindred can mark targets to Hunt. Successfully completing a Hunt permanently empowers Kindred's basic abilities. Every 4 hunts completed also increases Kindred's basic attack range.
Passive.summary: Kindred can mark targets to Hunt. Successfully completing a Hunt permanently empowers Kindred's basic abilities. Every 4 hunts completed also increases Kindred's basic attack range.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Marksman jungler who scales by collecting marks and duels with kiting dashes. Her R zone stops anyone from dying, turning fights around.
strengths: Strong kiting with Q dash and wolf (W) damage
Scales infinitely with marks (range and damage)
R prevents all deaths in the zone for a few seconds
E execute-style third hit on low targets
weaknesses: Squishy; dies to dive and point-and-click crowd control
Falls behind if she misses marks
R also saves enemies inside it
profile.curveNote: Fights after having Q, W and E for kiting duels.
profile.sustain: low – R heals everyone inside at the end

Q.notes: Short dash plus arrows; lowers cooldown inside W.

W.notes: Wolf zone attacks enemies; attacks build stacks.

E.notes: Slows, third hit deals bonus damage based on missing health.

R.notes: Nobody inside can drop below a small amount of health for its duration (allies and enemies); then heals.

Passive.notes: Marks on monsters/champions grant permanent stats.

profile.windowAgainst: R and Q down: all-in or dive her. Fight before she has many marks.
checks: R as 'invulnerable' is a simplification (health floor, not true invulnerability)
